title: Introducing Lockdown Mode and Elevated Risk labels in ChatGPT
summary: Introducing Lockdown Mode and Elevated Risk labels in ChatGPT to help organizations defend against prompt injection and AI-driven data exfiltration.
body: Introducing Lockdown Mode and Elevated Risk labels in ChatGPT to help organizations defend against prompt injection and AI-driven data exfiltration.
summaryZh: OpenAI在ChatGPT中引入了Lockdown Mode（锁定模式）和Elevated Risk（高风险）标签功能。这些安全特性旨在帮助企业用户防御提示词注入攻击及AI驱动的数据泄露风险，提升企业环境下的模型使用安全性。

aiReview.reasonZh: OpenAI引入Lockdown Mode和风险标签，旨在增强企业级应用的安全防御能力。
